messages:
alex: Heads-up — need to coordinate landing for PR #18421. Deploy freeze kicks in tonight; can we get a rebase/merge window or hold?

mia: which PR is that? link?

alex: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/18421 — fixes a KV cache leak that affects long batch jobs. CI green but needs one more approval.

sam: FYI last macOS run flaked, rerunning now with `./scripts/ci/rerun pr 18421`.

ci-bot: [CI] rerun queued for PR #18421 — jobs: linux, macos, integration — started. ETA ~8m.

mia: I can review and give approval, but want a quick staging smoke after merge. What's the rollback plan if canary shows issues?

jen (release-manager): Freeze start 2024-06-10 22:00 UTC. We can allow small bugfixes/security fixes before 21:30 UTC. There is a rebase window 2024-06-10 20:00–21:00 UTC for quick merges. Need heads-up if you plan to use it.

alex: We can target the 20:00–21:00 rebase window. Rebase looks trivial (one migration conflict). Pinging infra-owner for quick rebase & local verify.

sam: CI finished — all jobs green, macOS flake didn't repro. Approving now. :thumbsup:

mia: Approved from me as well. Will kick off staging smoke once merged.

infra-owner: Rebased on main, no conflicts. Ran migrations locally against snapshot db — looks fine.

alex: Sounds good. Plan: hold merge until 2024-06-10 20:05 UTC and land in rebase window so automated rollback can be staged. @release-manager please confirm unblock.

release-manager: Noted and unblocked for the 20:00 slot. If anything blocks during the window, escalate immediately to #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks everyone — will merge at 20:05 and follow with canary smoke.
